records.title: ViTs as backbones: Leveraging vision transformers for feature extraction
records.reason: 一次本文を取得できず方法・評価・限界を確認できないため、除外せずborderlineに残す。ScienceDirect DOI page did not provide retrievable full text in this session; publisher abstract was available.

records.title: MLLM Is a Strong Reranker: Advancing Multimodal Retrieval-augmented Generation via Knowledge-enhanced Reranking and Noise-injected Training
records.reason: 本文を確認したが、対象系統との接続またはLLM推論効率の実証が弱く、一般化可能性を確認できない。RagVL trains an MLLM as an image reranker and adds visual noise during training for multimodal RAG. Evaluation is on two image-retrieval/reasoning datasets; the paper does not report inference compute/latency or KV-cache improvements.

records.title: Ten Challenging Problems in Federated Foundation Models
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。The review organizes federated foundation model challenges; its efficiency discussion concerns training, communication and parameter efficiency, not LLM inference serving. No inference-time system method or serving evaluation was identified.

records.title: AB-UPT: Scaling Neural CFD Surrogates for High- Fidelity Automotive Aerodynamics Simulations via Anchored- Branched Universal Physics Transformers
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。AB-UPT is a CFD surrogate for aerodynamic field prediction using adaptive basis / uncertainty methods. Experiments concern fluid simulation accuracy, with no connection to transformer inference, model serving, or the linked attention systems.

records.title: Angular Steering: Behavior Control via Rotation in Activation Space
records.reason: 一次資料の要旨・本文が示す対象はLLM推論システムの計算量、メモリ、レイテンシ、スループット、KV cache、量子化、offload、servingの改善と技術的につながらない。Angular Steering rotates/steers model activations to alter behavioral traits. Its experiments concern behavioral alignment and do not establish lower compute, memory, latency, or higher serving throughput.
